reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: syncRoles is a live route (index.ts:68), non-test caller confirmed. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions table in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; gate cannot fire. Gate 3: src/api/ is explicitly in-scope. Code at rolesSync.ts:L25-29 queries members without .is('deleted_at', null), violating the invariant. Attack path: an authenticated operator calls POST /api/roles/sync with a soft-deleted member's discord_uid, causing Discord roles to be re-granted; requires Bearer token + knowledge of deleted discord_uid, so attack path is constrained to authenticated actors.
